messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — PR #7901 needs 2x approvals before the 00:30 UTC cutover. It's the kv-cache regression fix. I'm offline from 00:10, can someone pick up the approver baton? :pray:
aj: I can take final signoff if needed. Ping me when it's ready for a last smoke check. :eyes:
sasha: I reviewed earlier, left one small nits comment on error handling. If that's addressed I can +1.
maria: Thanks — the nit is fixed in the latest push (force-pushed). Patch is tiny, diff is in server/kv_cache_manager.py.
maria: ```diff
-    if not warm:
-        continue
+    if not warm and not fallback_enabled:
+        continue
```
aj: Looks good at a glance. Can you paste the CI smoke link? Want to confirm no flakey tests before I approve.
maria: CI passed on mainline smoke: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/98765 — only unrelated lint warnings.
sasha: Re-checking logs... nv100 nodes look stable in stress-run. No memory spikes.
taylor: Quick ops note — if for any reason cutover needs to be delayed, we should use the rollback branch `rollback/kv-789` and notify traffic to fallback pool. Ops-oncall will coordinate.
ops-oncall: Affirmative. I’ll be monitoring the cutover channel and can flip traffic if needed. Keep me in the thread for final merge message.
aj: I can approve once sasha posts +1. If maria is offline at 00:10, I’ll handle the merge (unless release-bot auto-blocks).
release-bot: Reminder: Cutover policy requires 2 explicit approvers (non-author) before the deploy window closes. Auto-merge disabled after 00:25 UTC.
sasha: +1 — looks clean to me now.
aj: +1 from me too. Taking the baton — I’ll merge at ~00:20 UTC and monitor smoke.
maria: Huge thanks everyone. Leaving the final merge to aj. Tag me if anything odd shows up, I can jump back in. :heart:
aj: Merging in 5.
release-bot: Merge executed: PR #7901 merged by aj at 00:21 UTC. Deploy job started: https://ci.redwood.example/deploys/12345
ops-oncall: Observing metrics. Latency and error-rate nominal so far. Will escalate if anything deviates.
aj: Closing loop — verified primary benchmarks, kv-cache warmups resumed. If no rollback by 00:40, consider this cutover successful. :white_check_mark:
